digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declaring an empty path list as authenticated none must be treated as neutral, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance so no child paths are inherited and the container is not classified all-none.

Scope precedence resolves to paths for any own/cited/inherited path, then explicit parent none, then all-live-none promotes only an undeclared parent to none, else unscoped; a parent declared paths is never promoted to none.
Cheap resign must sign the same child-derived scope using its immutable relation snapshot without network reads, refusing structurally on inconsistent snapshot state.
P9 passes declared-none leaves and all-declared containers, and advises only live undeclared children while offering both path declaration and --none as remedies.
Mixed paths+none containers sign only path-child dependencies, survive unrelated drift, and become stale when a declared child path changes.
